title: route picks its rung inside the nest
intention: Route's pick happens inside its nest: one postprocess sieve, pick, reads every measure-survivor's stamps and lets out exactly one rung (a preferred model if the domain prefers any survivor, else the cheapest, ties to the earliest combos row), a measure sieve untried cuts the rungs the caller names in exclude, and the two sorts after the shake are deleted.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: route() shakes the nest for cuts only and orders the survivors after it (cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/route.py:293 survivors.sort by cash_per_mtoken; :301 the domain prefers reorder). Akien 2026-09-15: 'capabilities checked first then the post process picked the cheapest ... if it's not like that now, that's a bug.'
traces_to: Outline 11.4.6 (route built with the nest, cheapest survivor first) and 16.2 (bands preprocess, measure, postprocess); Law 1; Q#82.
how: Add untried(view) and pick(view, stamps) to SIEVES in route.py; route() takes exclude=() and puts it and the domain's prefers in every subject view; its fire convention hands a postprocess sieve stamps as {key: (view, scores)}; survivors are the subjects rolling up 1.0, at most one; delete survivors.sort at :293 and :301. Red-first proof pins the pick against a frozen copy of the old order over fixtures.

clauses.claim: route.py contains no .sort( call and no sorted( over survivors, and import_sieve.phase_of derives band 2 for pick and band 1 for untried

over a fixture table (cost ties, a preferred model surviving, a preferred model cut, one survivor, the authored stacks) route's survivors is one rung, equal to the first rung of a frozen copy of the old sort-and-reorder over the same shake
pick catches every other measure-survivor with a finding naming the rung it picked
route(..., exclude=[label]) cuts that rung through untried with a finding naming it, and the pick moves to the rung the frozen old order listed next
when the measure sieves cut every rung, route raises RouteRefused naming each cut, as today
a counting fire shows the nest shaken once per route() call

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/route.py: untried(view) catches when view['label'] (the combo's 'provider/model') is in view['exclude']; pick(view, stamps) with stamps {subject key: (view, scores)} from route's fire: among the keys whose band-1 scores are all 1.0, the preferred ones if any (view['prefers']), then those at the minimum provider.cash_per_mtoken, then the smallest key; it catches the subject unless it is that key. Both join SIEVES. route() gains exclude: tuple = (), every subject view gains label, exclude and prefers (the domain row's, [] when none; an unknown domain still refuses before the shake). The fire lambda is lambda name, view, stamps=None: SIEVES[name](view) if stamps is None else SIEVES[name](view, {k: (subjects[k], s) for k, s in stamps.items()}). Survivors are the keys rolling up 1.0; the two sorts go; the docstring says one pick.

D2: cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/proofs/test_route.py: test_a_preference_reorders_survivors_without_changing_the_set and test_an_empty_preference_leaves_the_order_untouched become pick teeth (the preferred rung is the pick; general picks the same as bare), and the walk teeth that need two survivors pass exclude instead. Every other tooth stays.

D3: cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/intention+why.json: the charter's sentence that a preference never changes the survivor set becomes the pick, through bin/cairn artifact write --verb charter.

D4: the proof cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/proofs/test_route_picks_inside_the_nest.py, red-first, PROVES 1-6, the house runner; tooth 2 holds the old ordering inline (stable sort by cash_per_mtoken, then the stable prefers reorder) as the frozen reference.

out: host.py's walk re-asking route with exclude on HostUnreachable (its own ticket, cast beside this)

measured.saw: two sorts after the shake (:293 cost, :301 prefers); the shake fires (name, view) only
